metric: Unchanged check_asset/reference_distance: symmetric occupancy-weighted nearest-colour Lab distance. NumPy linear percentiles. Strictly above P90 is descriptive, never acceptance.
limitations: All submitted registry entries included, including self references and failed checks. No shape, semantic, style or visual acceptance inference. Identical colour support can score zero for different geometry. Existing references retained verbatim.

final_reference_audit.normalization_limit: D21 is post-production measurement normalization, not evidence that canonical references were attached during generation or were historically first accepted assets. Prompt-reference fulfillment remains PARTIAL. Producer reference mapping is preserved separately.
final_reference_audit.scope_limit: 383 submitted assets include baseline367 plus16 versioned scene-only entries; these are not383 independent generations. Every submitted row contributes once to percentile statistics.
final_reference_audit.self_reference_limit: Self references and byte-identical references are included, so zero distances do not establish independent agreement. Shadows have many self references.
final_reference_audit.metric_limit: Colour-support nearest-neighbour distances do not measure silhouette, proportions, alignment, readability, anatomy or semantic correctness. P90 flags are descriptive, not acceptance thresholds.
